external manifest-bound scientific-owner freeze record

## Proposed freeze scope

After exact owner disposition, the freeze may establish:

- the fixed-template, fixed-anchor, one-parameter amplitude estimator family;
- separately named authorized method subtypes and their non-fallback rules;
- exact normalization, response, support, validity, lifecycle, product, and
  uncertainty-role meanings;
- stochastic-model versus observed-payload typing;
- the local constrained-GLS theorem and its bounded optimality claim;
- typed unavailable routes and successor-authorship triggers; and
- the finite FLT-to-FRUIT producer envelope without FRUIT science.

## Satisfied owner dispositions

The owner selected the human title and explicitly disposed package-level,

## Freeze nonclaims

The freeze shall not establish an available numerical MAP parent or weighting
realization, a registered SCI-VAL profile, implementation conformity,
numerical adequacy, response/covariance fidelity, detection performance,
observational validation, readiness, production suitability, production
authorization, or Unity activity.
